title: CAPEC-66: SQL injection attack pattern
prerequisites: an application that builds queries from input
a channel that carries the input to the query
excerpt: The pattern walks from exploring how input is embedded, through experimenting with syntax that changes the query, to exploiting the resulting capability. It names the stages rather than a payload, which is why it is useful for ordering an exploitation attempt: exploration first, then a controlled experiment, then the smallest effect that demonstrates the change.
